Christ. She's either brave or stupid.
Jacob will see us through this. He always has.
Knock on wood.
Have you done it? Are the transmitters destroyed?
She just disappeared! It's gotta be the water!
So you're not an enemy, but you're not an ally.
I see. Try and stay out of our way.

I am bursting with pride! Amelia is with child! It is amazing how everything in life can change with such a simple event. Obviously we don't know the gender... but already we've discussed possible names. Perhaps Benjamin, after my grandfather. Or maybe Griffin? He was more infamous a Croft than even me!

No, Amelia wouldn't have it. Besides, she's certain it's a girl. She favors a classic such as Scarlett or Kate, though I've made some headway with Lara, a subtle nod to the Sun God Ra, and our days in Egypt where certainly this child was conceived.

I find myself thinking about this new life we've created... of how much she might be like us. For all my research into myths of immortality, I may have ignored the most obvious answer to the questions that plague me. We live on through our progeny... our genes, DNA, experiences... passed through the generations. Perhaps this is the simple truth of eternal life, and I've just been too stubborn to accept it.
They're tracking by sound... got to keep quiet.
Damn... it's not going to stay. Must be some way of keeping it in place.
Just... hurry... you're not the only one that's going to see the smoke...
Too late!

Deep below the holy ground of our city, we have found the source of the corruption. One of hell's winding tunnels snakes up and vomits forth a miasma of evil. There is no pattern to the demon's depredations, but his mark is plain. Men driven to wicked words and acts, as God's grace is driven from them. We take them here, to the mouth of hell itself, to drive out the demons. We do not always succeed. Often the poor wretches are too far gone, and they die when we drive the beasts out of them. It is heartbreaking to lose good people, but we must stand against the Devil, in all his forms.
I still can't raise anyone. Shit.
This isn't right, we walked right into this.
Let's hope they're on their toes back at the base.
My god...
If it makes you uncomfortable, spin around and face the wall.
Only one way to find out what's beyond...
Hell of a night to be stuck on patrol.
They were trying to rip off those locking beams. Maybe I can finish the job.
I understand. If you can find the time, you know where I'll be.
That's my grandmother. She was there. Right where you're standing...
How did these animals survive down here?
Did you find the bird? We need those messages.
We're blind without it.
...The Prophet spoke, and the soldiers laid down their arms...
You're welcome. Now, go and sort your life out.
Did you see those poor bastards stuck in the ice?
We should move on soon. We get lost in here, we are fucked.
Your "Witch" is clever. Everything in this Vale is arranged to perpetuate the myth of Baba Yaga,
and the pollen does the rest. The last time I saw the lift, it looked nothing like this.
<Screaming>
How can I help?
I keep hearing things down here... Like... footsteps, but it's all muffled.
Must be hiding places like this all over this valley...
It's Jacob's path... It's got to be...
Hey you. This one's out cold, I'll leave the rest for you.
Going to starve out here...
Damn it!
Got to be a way past this fence.
Thank you for your help.
We'll get the boar meat smoked, and then it should last for a while.
We'll always need more, but it's a start.
We're reloading the trebuchet, hold on!
Nooo!!
If that's what you call them.
You'll run into some trouble-
Have to find something to eat, or else...
More ruins.
Let's hope we don't get tapped to go next...
These ruins are incredible...

Ancient AK's and bows. They're cut off out here.
Yeah... Let's give it a few more minutes, then we're gonna have to climb.
Yeah, we got to fix that lift.
Is there anything you need?
Shit... where did he go?
Show yourself, Lara.
Jonah, is that you?!
Good luck, Lara. We're gathering everyone together.
We'll be ready for what's next.
No, I don't smoke.
Grab a hold of the line, we're here!
I knew... ever since the tomb in Syria... I knew you and I were meant for something more.
We'll have to rebuild half of the upper village when the invaders are gone.
They're sending another team inside the mines, to map the ruins.
This mural depicts a peace treaty... possibly with the Rus... "The Prophet spoke, and they laid down their swords..." He came unarmed, spoke their language... and brokered the peace....
They tended to the sick here.
The survivors must have suffered.
Damn! Almost had it.
Anyway, this site should be pacified. Should be a quiet patrol.
These new arrowheads seem blunt.

It will take its toll on her...
Grandpa's awake. He says... He says it's her, Lara. The Witch is my grandmother. She's alive.
I can't promise you anything, but I'll look.
Got to pull them both down somehow...
He's almost gone. We're not going to get anything from him.
The best we can do is buy you some time.
I'll see you on the other side.
I'll go and ask them, but I can't promise you they'll come.
Damn it... got to be careful.
Finish her! We gotta get out of here, before we all burn!
Well, they better figure it out.
I keep wondering who we pissed off...
...when the drought of a thousand days choked the land,
the Prophet led his people to the waters of life.
Jacob...
I can find it... Okay, here.
Keep your eyes open for falling ice.
Alright, let's get this hatch open.
We'll go in when our backup arrives.
Someone scratched something below.
Directions to something hidden...
Yeah, a few times. Not up close yet.
It's weird.... Like they're stuck in time.
I can't figure out how we got stuck with this patrol.
I'm close, Lara...
Looks like I can pull that into place...
Still no radio contact?
Damn. Be with God, my friend.
These will come in handy.
We just tried a few minutes ago. No one on the other end but static.
Shame... would love to spend some more time to study this place...
Dillon!? Dillon? Shit.
Morse! Dillon's gone!
Is it? And what are we protecting anymore? The Source went with Jacob.
We all have to ask ourselves some difficult questions, and I won't judge those that answer differently.
It has to be the outpost the Soviets built, to study the ruins.
My grandmother was a scholar, and they brought her here to help with their research, but...
That was the last time Grandpa ever saw her. There was only one survivor,
an officer who stumbled out a few weeks later... He said the Witch... made them do things.
It's a rifle suppressor... now this... this was worth it.
We're exposed, and we need to secure our defenses, or the next attack will be the last.
You hear something?

Negative Sword 2 - hold on station.

Smart.

Sound off, who's got a visual?
Keep wasting your time.

That statue... it's unstable...
Faster, move!
I can see them... Did the rest of your people get out?
Establish a perimeter!
Hey, hey, hold up!
These bastards are resourceful. They might have set up some traps.
Hammer 1 is down! I repeat - Hammer 1 is down!
Come then... let me embrace you myself.
Send who, exactly? Everyone's heading down to the lower village to prepare.
I'm telling you, you have to improvise for now.
Shit. Get ready... she's out there.
God... No... Got to get out of here...
Prisoner:  Wait!
Let me out.
I can help you.
Lara:  I can't trust you.
We may not be enemies.
I can see that.

I know the layout,
I know the land.

I'm Jacob.
Lara.
Take this.
In case we get separated.

Those... those are ancient.
What did they find?
No good... too much water.
Is that you Lara? I think I know why you're here. Come on up, let's talk.
This is our valley. We fought off the Mongols...
and years later, the Soviets as well.
We will not roll over and let Trinity take it.
Eh... Be safe, Lara.
If you see that logo, then get the generator connected to the water filtration pumps started up.
Do you think you can stop them?
I'll let you know when I get there.
Looks like this was deliberately sabotaged.
If I could just... pull it open somehow...
Then prove it! Face me now, Lara.
Have you... Have you even looked at a map since we got here? Doesn't matter which way we go, we're weeks away from anywhere on foot.
The followers of the Prophet fled,
but they were attacked... in Syria.
Lord Croft:  Roth is determined that I should learn how to shoot.
However, he tried to teach me today. I was utterly hopeless.
I've always said in the field you can't go wrong with a stout stick and good boots.
I told him I was a man of words, not of weapons.
He laughed and said that he hoped I could find the right words to slow down a charging bison.
I told him that that's what he was for. Bless him for trying, though.
I don't think there'll be anymore lessons somehow.
Jonah... Hold on...
Ah.... shit.
Alpha 2 is gone sir! She's taking us out one by one.
We have to have faith.
God will watch over us... He must.
Good enough for now... Still need to find more.
Shhh, shhh...
Oh god... what are those things?
That's a hit! Just a few more...
He would have helped me fulfill my destiny, but in the end... it's fallen to you.
No. Far as I can tell, we're cut off out here.
You find anything?
Don't screw this up. Best pay you can find, but they will not tolerate mistakes.
Jacob:  <via radio> Lara! I could use your help.
Oh shit, is that what I think it is?
Last night with Jacob. He's still shaken up but he's not hurt.
Okay, spread out! Find something to pry it loose.
If you go hunting, make sure you use everything you can, even the hide.
Killing may be necessary, but waste is a sin.
Looks like Ana was right about the Lost City...
You see that plane crashed in the mountains when we came in?
Lord Croft:  Lara. Refusing to use the door again, I see.

Come here, you little monkey.
Are you going on another adventure?
Yes.
My greatest one yet.
Well, I've decided that I should be your assistant.

But this business... it's too dangerous.
Lara, listen to me.
Someday you’re going to make such a mark on this world.
You're going to make me so proud.
Give me a moment, darling. I need to take this.
How the hell is she still alive?
If you want to help, you should head down to the lower village.
I mean, why the hell do they stay here, in the middle of Siberia? Why don't they just leave?
Who are you? Why are you doing this?
You there? Shit.
Just the ones they think might know something about the Atlas.
Konstantin's gonna ask them a few questions...
They've got the rest back up near the cathedral.
Your father didn't take his own life!
Please...
Anyone can say they'll die for a cause.
But you all weep and beg when the end comes.
Last chance. Where are the rest of your people?
Konstantin:  <via radio> I'm on my way.
If not, then make sure to reconnect the conduits to the water filtration system.
If it keeps getting colder, the pipes back at the facility are liable to burst.
Civilization isn't a one way street.
Something must have happened to knock them back into the dirt like this.
Call out, anyone got a visual?
Incredible.
The style looks ancient, but it depicts...
A train... The coming of the Soviets.
Hey, we've got some serious structural damage over here...
I don't think this tunnel is stable.
This might work! Just have to tether it...
She's there! Up high!

My newest work is almost finished but old feelings are resurfacing again. That old pang of fear. Suspicions and paranoia.

Strangers outside the manor house. Phone calls coming in at odd hours. I've moved all of my work into my office. Only I have the key.

Two nights ago, I mentioned my fears about Trinity to Ana. She laughed it off. But... but... her laugh was a second delayed. And last night, after I'd gone to bed, I heard her downstairs. I swear she was speaking to someone.
 
Lara. Lara is the only one I can trust.
My god... These ruins... part of the Lost City... It has to be.
The people in the Catacombs, below the tower... They would have died up there, without you.
I suppose we're free, now.
We could leave if we wanted to...
I'm grateful for your help here, Lara.
I can't thank you enough. Until next time.
Lara:  Jonah!
Jonah:  You look terrible.
Terrible but... happy.
I was right, Jonah.
Dad was right.
The Divine Source is real!
I wish he was here to see this.
He'd be proud of you.
Sofia told me what you've done for her people.
Sofia:  Lara.
It's good to see you, Sofia.
Jacob is waiting for you in the observatory.
Feer oh etta yall TAY ROH!
You'll never be able to hit it!
We'll give it some time. I'll contact you again soon.
Will I find the Atlas in the Acropolis, Jacob?
This is insane. No one's gonna be out on a night like this.
Mayday, mayday, mayday, this is Fireteam Bravo, calling for immediate assistance. We've engaged an unknown hos-
Let it fly!
God damn. This is getting out of hand.
Something I can do for you?
Fall back on me! If you can hear me, retr-
Try leaving the city once in a while.
There... that should hold me for a while.
Got to time that a bit better...
No, I just... I'm glad I could help.
Yeah. Perfect for an ambush...
Hold still...
There... at least this counterweight still works...
Wolves hunt at night. Be cautious when you're out there.
We knew someone would come, eventually.
We can't thank you enough, Lara.
Are you headed for those towers? If we can't shut down the production of the toxin... then...
Those things are still around here. Don't drop your guard.
Will you head up there, make sure they're all right, and drive that damned bear away?
We'll shut them down. I promise.
Good. We finally get what we came for?
Yeah, it's like ancient napalm. Hell of a sight.
Roger that. If someone comes through here, we'll spot them.
Hmm... I hope they try.
Jonah! How does it look?
Listen.... the fuel ...
you have to.... please...
...What is that sound?
We think the natives are guarding it?
Itchy trigger finger, sorry.
Should be a way to shoot down that platform.
Hello there.
Get behind me. She's mine.
Think the rain will keep the natives inside?
Damn it...

With Amelia gone, the Manor is a different place. A dimness pervades, a quiet I can't stand. Even though Lara is too young to understand what has happened, she also senses the change. She's asked after her mother only once and I'm afraid my reaction must have terrified her.

I will need Winston more than ever these next few months to help look after her. I never quite realized how much grief can consume a man... but I am utterly consumed. I know I can't escape the pain, but I will try my damnedest to avoid it. I will seal the West Wing, for as long as I live in this place. It will remain exactly as Amelia left it.

Perhaps someday Lara can find her own answers there.
We keep going until the last moment.
One arrow might make all the difference.
Make them count.
You're stronger than I thought. A worthy opponent. Let's finish this.
This damn truck is dead.
Lay down your weapons, or you will be shot!
If Trinity finds the Source... then we will have failed. That can't happen.
So, what's the plan now?

So you're just going to what... look up "Trinity" on the net and just call every listing? Think, you idiot. If we want to get rich out here, it's up to us. There's got to be something valuable in these ruins.
What the fuck was- Oh shit!
I'm still wondering how the hell they got a crane down here.
If you're heading up into the facility, keep an eye out for our leader... if he's still alive.
She's here!
We made it, Dad.
Greek Fire... were they trying to recreate the formula?

You suppose we could learn how to fly it?
I know you're busy-

Trinity Soldier:  Where is the Divine Source?!
Tell me!

Where is it?

The Atlas! It will show you the way!
Okay. Tell me about this Atlas!
So the Soviets found this cavern, and then just left it?

A wolf den, they won't look there.
But I can't clear it out on my own, not like this.
A man can dream.

So, what's the deal with the comm traffic down here?
I can use those armor pieces to distract him.

What's our status?

Weapons free. Let's take her out.

and we've done all we can, but they're falling apart now.

Report in.

"The Deathless Ones". An elite military unit that vanished in the 10th century. But they didn't vanish... they came here... with the Prophet...

<via radio> Heads up, we haven't restored the uplink, expect interference on all transmissions.

...several casualties... men are dead and scattered...

I will not fail.

<coughing>
And you will have it. Don't lose faith, Ana.

Please. Just find it. My time is running out.

This manuscript could be it: the singular piece of research that will bring all of my work on the Immortal Soul together.
Revelations are coming quickly. There is much work to be done.

I finally introduced Richard to the family.  It went precisely how I imagined. Icy, but polite grace from mother. Indifference and disinterest from father. And thinly veiled contempt from Atlas. Of course they don't approve. To them, Lord Croft is the man who stole away their beloved daughter and ruined her long standing engagment (I was never going to marry that repugnant Earl of Farringdon anyway).

One might think they would be happy that I was being courted by a genuine Lord of the Realm. It just happens to be Richard Croft - in their eyes, the man who single handedly ruined a once great family. 

But there's nothing to be done now. Watching how Richard dealt with their subtle insults and disrespect... such grace and calm. I know he did it for me and confirmed what I can no longer deny... I am absolutely, hopelessly in love with him. He doesn't care a wit what anyone thinks of him...and in truth, neither do I.

It will break my mother's heart, but I cannot live the life she imagined for me. My time with Richard has only made this clearer.
I'm at the top, Nadia.
Come on! We better get moving.

Lara:  So much violence and death.

a duty handed down from the past.

Who's there!?

Stay still!
Check all these doors!
Hmmm,
did this open the secret door from the inside?
Hope I'm not trapped in here.

If you can find a way out there, the fuel for the fire is on the old lift. But be careful, that tower is old.

<laughing> Little bird!

We can no longer wait for our brothers outside the mine to begin their resistance. Now!

Weapons free. Kill everything that moves.
Just keep climbing!

What I've sacrificed! What I face-
<coughing>
I'm fine.
Life has not been kind to either of us.
But I swore I'd always protect you.
Now who's being sentimental?
I promise you, all of this will be worth it in the end.
With the Divine Source, you will live.
But more importantly, you will live in a world cleansed of sin.
Send your men to this settlement. Find out what they know.

Let me have my pleasures.

<alarms resound throughout the complex>

Do not let them find you. Go!

Another mural...

corresponds to a number... but which one.

It's done. We'll die here, thanks to Carraldus and the madness of the Order of Trinity. My ship will never see water again. We entered the Glacial Sea too far into the winter, would have been turned back, but Carraldus would not abandon this lost Prophet. He and his dead-eyed warriors seized control. He forced the ship through shallow tributaries, until we could go no further. Then he made my crew construct sled runners, and the bastard forced us to tow the ship over land. It was death and excommunication to deny him. But it was death either way. I will make sure he dies here, with us. I have always kept a little poison at the ready in case the ship was taken. Did Dad build all of this just to
keep his research safe?

could there be something else beneath the manor?

Collapsed...

This was something functional. I see ropes, and wooden gears...

bear the idea of removing any of her
belongings...

YOU CANNOT HIDE FOREVER!

or some kind of evidence of what happened to Mom in the Manor...
somewhere.
No!
She's behind the pillars!

the combination has to be in here somewhere.

the world is not what we think.

this Crypt was here all along.

Argh- Anyone!
I tripped a fucking snare out here, I need some hel-

Because he blamed himself for the tragedy. But he did return. We just have to patient.

I was going to take that one myself, but you're the one with the gold.

I can hear you moving...

Right behind.

It's over. I have done all that I could, and my Amelia is still cold and dead. Roth first scowled at my designs, then he pleaded with me not to go through with the ritual. Not because he feared it might work, but because he feared what I might do when it failed.

And it has failed, there is no doubt in that. I prepared everything according to my research. When I dropped the stone into the elixir and held it to her lips, I thought, for the barest moment, that it had worked. The hour was midnight, and my pocket watch stopped inexplicably... there was a charge in the air, like the moment before a lightning strike. 

For a heartbeat, I imagined that my life was being drawn from me as one empties a glass, in order to be poured back into Amelia. I would have welcomed death if the last thing I saw were her eyes, clear and alive again.

But the moment passed. Amelia is still dead, and I was no Orpheus. We will return to the manor, and lay her to rest. I owe her that much.
Okay. First, the seed pods... the flowers grow inside the caves around there...

Stole a small length of rope to replace my stolen belt. Viktor begged me not to take it. I looked away from him when I pulled it free of his belt loops. He's sick. I can tie the rope taut enough to keep my slacks from falling, but it bites deep into the bones that jut from my hips. No one would recognize me now. Fat, jolly Josef evaporates away. Maybe when the last of my body is gone, my spirit will drift out of this valley on the cool breeze, thoughtless and free. I like that. I'll hold tight to that, today in the mines.

You can never achieve anything like that again.
I'm not surprised he asked her to marry him as soon as he got the idea.

Still, it taught me independence, how to look after myself.
Important lessons as it turns out.
I think we saw a weapon cache on our last flyby. You want to take a look?

Goddamn coat is leaking again.

The smoke can't hide you forever!

That we have, thanks to you. This will give us an edge over the invaders.

If we can get these towers repaired, it will give us an advantage over the invaders,
and it will help us reach the upper levels of the ruined towers. Will you help?
The invaders took prisoners in the last assault. We need to rescue them, but we have our hands full with the wounded here.
Damn it, they're on to me.
It didn't cave in after that battle, so I'm sure that's the least of our worries.
I don't have time for this...
Damn... the counterweight is stuck...
Yeah, Ops thinks they have another hiding place somewhere, but the village is swept clean.
Don't take my leg. Please.
Thought I'd give them a little time alone, while I look around some more.
Yeah... look...
Keep this close to your chest, but...
I don't think it's money they're after.
No time, go! Go!
Croft?
Oh Dad... no... don't do it... please...
Jonah:  What do you think?
Lara:  We're close to something, Jonah.
I can feel it.
Just this last stretch to the top.
All right.
Let's see what's up there.
If we knew, you wouldn't be looking.
Documents, maps, anything that might confirm the intel.
We will win, because we must. But we will not win by boasting.
Jacob! Jacob, are you there, can you hear me?

I can make it!
I've got to get through that door.
No, I was sent to help clean up the island.
...After Croft escaped.
Huh.
I don't know what this is, but it's definitely solid gold.
You're strong... smart. I understand what Ana saw in you. But you chose the wrong path.
Yeah, probably not.
Thank you, Lara. We are in your debt.
Lord Croft:  Lara has accused me of paranoia, again.

I'm ready! Go!
A history lesson... This place has its own scars.
I won't forget this Lara. Thank you.
Take her out!
Jacob will see us through this. He always has.

Mandrake root and various herbs.

We do... A bear has made his home in the caves by the upper village. Someone has to drive him out of there and deal with him.

Let her run off, we've lost too many already.

I stood up to my family's criticism, stood in defense of Richard and our love. But as my new life began in Croft Manor, doubt set in. How could love flourish in these cavernous halls and endless passageways? Had I made a terrible mistake?

I have never been more delighted to be wrong. Richard welcomed me to the Manor - my new home - with a game. It was a clue, written in jumbled words from five different languages, but it pointed the way forward. The next clue was a seemingly blank piece of parchment in the kitchen, where the heat of a candle revealed a message written in lemon juice. 

I followed each step, grinning like a child as I solved his riddles and chased the trail to its end: a white cloth stretched on the lawn where a picnic was laid out. We laughed and ate, and my doubt vanished with the last of the morning mist. 

Love can, and will, endure.
We're reloading now...
There's no going back now.
Confirmed heat sig. Ready to engage!
I don't know. It's a perfect night for an ambush.
Dad? No... it can't be...
Best seat in the house...
My grandfather snuck out of the village in the night.
I think he's headed for the Wicked Vale where the witch, Baba Yaga lives.
I was trying to catch up with him when the invaders caught me.
Fire!

Handwritten... this is the only copy.

Do you believe all that?
What can I do for you?

That's not going to hold me for long...
Regroup!
Hmm... what's this blade?
We're always in need of supplies. Our survival depends on it.
<via radio>Survey team, this is Overwatch. Please respond.

These aren't fresh recruits, these were career killers.
And they weren't jumpy, they were messed up.
Said they saw phantoms dressed in armor down there.
Their anniversary was in October... but which day?
I can't believe I don't know this.
There's got to be another clue somewhere.
Just take it slow. Stay sharp.
Mmm. The Soviets did as well.
So we stay beneath the trees, they can't hit what they can't see.
But I didn't know who we were dealing with.
Just let me die...
You've almost got it darling... here... let me show you.
Hmmm... I've got to bring it lower...
They're heretics. Worshipping some false idol. You can't expect them to be thinking straight.
Lot of boots on the ground. Whatever they have planned, I think this could be a big one.
You've done well, Lara. We are in your debt.
Careful! There's a bear up there, big mean bastard. We only just got away.
Hey, uh. Before you go throwing stones...
So, this was some sort of military academy?
Creepy as hell and... oh shit. Now they're running straight for you. Get ready.
Contact! They're here!
...but I want to help. Let me show you that I'm on your side.
A few days ago I would have said you were crazy. Today.... Not so sure.
You're back. Good. You can help.
Fascinating...
Let's circle around and find them. Can't let them get away...
Who's up there? Jacob? We need help!

They were almost wiped out, and those that lived struggled to survive the coming years. Without the city, they were forced to adapt, surviving from the land. Many believed the Prophet was dead in the years that followed, but he returned to protect what remained of his people.
Fucking animals don't sleep. Keep your guard up.
Show yourself!
Well, at least no one else will be out on a night like this.
There's no way we're going back the way we came.
So cold... so tired.
No one's seen Ana since the incursion have they?
Sword 1 arriving in sector 5. We are ready to engage!
Right behind you.
Some sort of disaster struck, and it doesn't look like they ever really recovered.
Wonder what the hell it could have been...
Give us time, Lara, we're reloading.
You see the blinds up in the trees? The natives must have built them for hunting.
If you're not here to fight, then you should head somewhere safe.
If I could lower the gate, I should be able to climb higher...
Hands in the air! Now!
Affirmative! Send them back to hell!
That's it! Now to get out of here...
Stay as quiet as you can, we're getting out of here.
NO! My destiny lies in the Chamber of Souls...
I've come too close to be stopped now.
Those crypts have to be nearby... got to keep looking...
They're on their way back to the village?
You're alive, good.
We got most of the wounded to safety, but the invaders returned.
They've taken the upper village.
I can't just now, but I will find you when I can.
Move goddammit! Get the package, and lets get the fuck out here!
Got to attack him while he's distracted
Incredible... There's so much we've lost...
But we will find it again...
Here, it's a small price for this wisdom.
Hello again. What can I do?
I tried to get her to go, but she wouldn't.
Says she's waiting for something. Something you're supposed to bring her.
Got be hiding in here somewhere... Maybe there's a trail.
I have to cut it off. I'm sorry.

Negative.

Bastard!
Light the crates, burn them out!

Look at all this...
Why were they carrying so much wealth with them?
Come on, you can do this.
I still can't fathom it.
Jacob is dead.
After all these years...
Begging your pardon, but don't you have somewhere to be?
Oh god!
Ah yes! The Mongols left something nearby...
A Gulag. Prison work camp for dissidents and other enemies of the state.
They called it "Freedom Station." Someone had a thing for irony.
Got to shoot her... keep her pinned down, or else she'll cut herself free!
Lara, may I speak with you?
I can try...
We have to be silent. Make sure no one sees you.
I know, Winston. I just want... oh no, I didn't even see that!
Almost there.
The Chamber of Souls is through that gate.
An abandoned Cold War installation...
What the hell is Trinity doing down there?
Why's that lucky?
Did we really lose a full company when they broke through into the ruins?
We're about two minutes from you. Stay safe.
Hey. Stop killing our chickens...
We're almost done evacuating the wounded here.
I'll join you soon.
God's not here, it's just me and you, my friend. Let's talk.
Hope this was worth it...
Not going to freeze to death now... but still need to stay warm.
Shit. He still thinks the prisoners are a threat?
There we are...
Still cold, but... out of danger for the moment.
Let's keep moving. There has to be an exit over here.
No, but it doesn't look good.

two pairs of footprints, both women with modern shoes.

and only one pair of footprints.

Let's check downstairs.
Well, your intent may be more noble. But outsiders all come looking for the same thing.
Hello there.

What happened out here?
Damn it!
<coughing>
Confirmed heat sig. Ready to engage!
<via radio> Roger! All engage!
Watch your fire!
Drake is full of shit, and you know it.
Ch'oll ee ka to-

Serafima...
*Speaking in Russian*

Will she be all right?

Family never is.
Oh, I know. I know.
Thank you, Lara. For everything.
Day's wasting. Got to keep moving.
Just one outside, but he never comes down here without Konstantin.

I think often on what it must've been like for Carter opening Tutankhamun's tomb. That moment of anticipation, of standing on the threshold of something so momentous. I live on that threshold... awaiting the revelation inside a tomb I have yet to find.
I'll see what I can do.
Who else is here?
Fresh kill... no meat but... maybe something else I can use...
Kyrie eleison... Profétés eleison... Kyrie eleison...
Yes.
We can't let anyone know you're here. Keep silent.

Whoever brings her in is going to be rich.

No more hiding.
The cave across the bridge. If you could get rid of the wolves, I'll be safe there.

I'm sure we could give it a go.
Is that Jacob?
The helicopter is too fast... we'll never be able to hit him.
I'm glad I'm here.
Okay, let's get that door down.
Was this their marketplace?
What were they pulling out of the mines here?
If you can help, let me know.
So far I've been lucky. None of our patrols are anywhere inside the mine.
We're loading up the trebuchet, hold on!
I heard we located the objective...

Something?
Just keep your eyes peeled for traps.
They may have left some surprises for us on the way out.
Stunning... we made it, Dad.
Magnificent...

Move again and I'll kill you. Try me. C'mon, try me!

Across the steppes, and into the frozen wastes, they travelled East in search of safety and freedom. They passed the edge of the Empire, and crossed into the frontier, protecting the Divine Source. The journey was perilous, many succumbed to the cold and starvation, but the miracles of the Prophet kept them going forward.
I need another set of eyes. We need all the information we can gather.
Of course. Thank you.
This architecture predates the rise of Eastern Orthodoxy.
And there's no other way through.

It's not... God...
Spread out... they have to be here somewhere.

What's going on?
Yes of course.

We're heading into a war zone now.
You better be sure about this.
Lara:  We're close.
There should be an oasis in the canyon just ahead.

Just keep driving, please.
It's your money.
Something isn't right...

You bast-

Get us out of here!
Shit... shit!
Oh no, no. No!
No, no, no...!
Lara, they all stopped and turned toward you at once, like a flock of birds.
You've been down below, to the heart of the Old City...
None of us have been down there in generations.
Goddamn it, it is fucking freezing in this place.
That's where I need to go.
Another winch there... just got to move it into position.
They were scared, and cut off down there. That would make anyone jumpy.
Maybe I can connect it to that rope spool...
Soviet soldiers... something awful happened here...
Gee roh ah no!
We dropped one of those things, took four of us, and we still lost a man.
You can kill them but... they don't stay dead.
I did what I could. I'm glad to have been here.
Ee kanna gor wan tey ah genn....
Almost got this.
NA!
Make a fire... anything... just need to... warm up.
God is with us!
We're pinned down, someone, help!
Okay...
Dad's ledger has to be in here somewhere.
Hopefully it has the combination to the safe.
Come out Lara. It is time!
Looks that way. This must have been where they were making all of the Greek Fire...
Oh shit! What the fuck is that?
This is all I need. Konstantin isn't going to be happy about this.
Someone else was attacking Trinity in the darkness beneath the Cathedral.
Could it be the Deathless Ones Sofia spoke of?
And if so, what part do they have to play in all this?
I have so many questions.
But for now, I'm just relieved...
Jonah's alive!
I should have known he'd come looking for me.
And thank god Jacob's people found him before he ran afoul of Trinity.

but I have to admit... I'm happy he's here now.

I was there, in the old city. They were... I mean, they're not human.
Here... we... go...
There's a patrol coming towards you, and there are some valuable artifacts we must keep hidden from them.
Move out, and make it quick.
What do you expect from these backwood savages?
Hold your fire... just a deer.
If we can get back to Jacob, he'll be okay.
Let me guess. My father doesn't believe we can be safe here, without Jacob. He wants to go and hide.
He's coming up to supervise operations at the site?
It's got to be something underground, right? Geothermal vents, or something.
Hope that was enough.
Not enough... but it's something.
I'm making my way to the mine entrance at the top of the facility.
Can you meet me there?
My weapons are no use against that chopper.
Don't think I've cracked this yet... I'll have to come back.
Why do you surround yourself with those weaker than you?
It's not in position. Got to be a way to aim it...
Clever girl... but you should know by now,
winning isn't everything.
Queen to King's Bishop Six. Check.
The flowers here... they're not exactly the same as the ones in the valley.
She must have been breeding them, selecting the most potent ones...
Oh goddammit!
I used to like the sound of rain, you know?
Shit Lara, you know I'm meant to die on a beach, right?
What I really want is to get whatever cash or anything else we can sell. Then, yeah, I want to play a few hands of poker.
Looks like their was some sort of struggle. They think the train crash was deliberate.
Hey, did you get more details about what happened underneath the cathedral?

We will, Nadia, we didn't come this far just to fail.

Swing me over!

I don't think I've ever seen the stars that bright.

The city was a marvel... if half of this can be believed, it was the rival of Constantinople, or any of the cities of the East. Still, they feared their old enemies would find them, so they guarded their borders, and kept word of the city from spreading for as long as they could...
You bastards.

Go back!

Would you have left me?
I'd have thought about it.
What makes you think I didn't?
So what makes you risk so much to come here?
The Divine Source.

But I want to know why.
When I was young, it was just my father and I.
He was an archeologist too.
In his last years, he was obsessed with myths about immortality.
Of course, no one believed him...
...including me.
Our last conversation was a fight.  He...
He took his own life.
I thought I'd come to terms with it, but...
Something else happened.
And I saw something that I thought was impossible.
It changed everything.
I realized my father was right.
He died alone and broken.
But he died for something.
So you believe the Divine Source is real?
I honestly don't know.
But if there is any truth to it, I have to find out.
It... it needs to be researched and studied.
It could make a difference to the world. It's not something to be hidden away.
A difference is not always for the best.
Would you wish Trinity to have the secret to immortality?
Of course not.
Then I would ask you not to abandon your quest, but to alter its path.
Join me and my people.
Help us repel Konstantin and Trinity.
And after that's done?
Then you leave our valley untouched, but knowing that you've done the right thing.
No, I'm sorry. I can't do that.
Can't or won't?

If I give up now...
You'd feel like you'd be letting him down?
Not just him.
I need answers, Jacob. I need to understand.
You're leaving?

You rest.
I'll be back soon.
Okay, it's filled. Should be able to open it with that lever.

Take my hand!
Lara:  Thanks...

It's amazing…
but the snow coming off those peaks is a bad sign.

This codex details the archery techniques of the foes of the Byzantine empire...

Nothing too important, Lara. Estate business and such.
Yeah... no telling where they could be.
Something about the job? Something they aren't telling us?

What the fuck were you thinking?
I could use a fire...
Laid out for burial... a mass grave...

Lara,

I expected a sort of crushing finality to grip me when we returned to the manor, to lay Amelia to rest. Instead, as the mausoleum stone slid into place, I felt... a sort of peace and energy, one that I confess caught me entirely off guard. This was not the terminus of our story, and I was fool to think so. Her body may be gone, but her spirit still resides here, in the manor, in me, in Lara. Her soul is forever twined with mine, and death is just... a momentary interruption. I walked out of that cold quiet into a sunlight that burned my eyes, and I have ever been more sure.

The offer came in the post last week, and I still haven't told Richard. He flew ahead to Tibet, where I will meet him shortly. I never told him I was submitting my work, never thought there was chance of being accepted. But a gallery tour is not something I can pass up. The show will take me away from England for over a year. I'll begin in New York and travel across the United States, and God, I'm giddy even writing those words. 

When Richard and I were married, I was prepared to relegate my painting to a hobby, but it was Richard who objected, who gave me my atelier and studio. Without that support, I might still be painting boring landscapes. Now I can't shake the foolish sensation that leaving now would be a betrayal. 

He will laugh at that and insist that I accept, even as I know it will break his heart to be apart. He never once asked me to sacrifice any part of my life for his. I have, of course, in a thousand small ways over the years, but he would never ask.

The discussion can wait, and I will join him in Tibet. I won't cast a shadow over this find. I will be by his side in his triumph, as I know he will stand by my side, in time.
Sofia has the weight of the whole community on her shoulders now.
It will take its toll on her...

The conference was, of course, a disaster. I might as well have been boo'd from the podium.  And yet... I am in the best mood I've been in years. I met someone there. An admirer. She approached me after the slaughter. I nearly flinched, expecting her to continue the beating.

But instead she simply asked to hear more about my work. And when I started to talk, her questions were not loaded with cynicism. 

Instead they were intelligent. Almost innocent in their inquisitiveness.  We spoke for hours.

She says her name is Ana. I've invited her to dine with me when we're all back in London.
KA!

Lara,

Indeed, where have you been the past few weeks? My secretary discovered that you booked a flight to Turkey on the 20th. You can't have been simply sightseeing, as your customs claims suggest. I know you're up to something, and I'll be damned if let you use the Croft assets to indulge the same obsession that led to my sister's death.

It's not too late to relinquish your claims on the Manor voluntarily. If you refuse, I will find a way to cut you off.

Trinity being here, the people they're hurting...
that's down to me.
I led them here.

of getting to the Divine Source first and using it to benefit the world...

For everyone who's gone before, for everyone I've lost...
just keep moving.

When the uranium ore was nearly gone, I feared our operation was at an end. But even as we moved to close the shaft, fate intervened. We found a chamber, half destroyed by a cave in, but clearly made by the hands of man. The artifacts inside are ancient, nearly a thousand years old, untouched since the tomb was been sealed. We redouble our efforts, instead of mining, the workers now search and retrieve the artifacts inside. The natives of the valley, their resistance once broken, now bristle at this new assignment, as if they do not wish the relics to be seen. We will need to make an example of a few young men, before their dark looks lead to something more.
These should make a sizeable explosion. Gotta be careful...
Hey, uh. Before you go throwing stones...
Whoa! There's lots of loose ice up here.
Got to get past that bear...

The Maria Adula is trapped. The ice gave way, her spine snapped in two. No matter. While I hoped to wield her cannons against the False Prophet, we will continue on foot. I have six of the Order of Trinity's best and we have been stockpiling food and supplies while the sailors starved. They do not know it yet, but they will give their life for the cause. My men and I will find our way out of these icy caves and continue on foot. Before the ship was swallowed by the ice, to the south, we heard music. That will be our first stop. But first I must rest. The cold has sunk into my bones, and I am drowsy. Just a little sleep...
We'll probably catch a few more stragglers slinking around the woods.

If you can help, please respond at once.

Got it!

Bring the Atlas to me in our observatory in the mountains.

Jacob?

The followers of the Prophet were builders, engineers, scholars, doctors, as well as soldiers and common folk. Shit...

Not now, we've a fight comin'.

Exactly.

Do not let them find you. Go!

Konstantin's up in the prison...

Here we go... just have to cut the rope
Down!

Trinity.

This architecture predates the rise of Eastern Orthodoxy.

Croft was there, that much I know for sure, but...

She's here!
How far are you gonna take this?
Almost got it.
Oh goddammit!
I used to like the sound of rain, you know?
This mural speaks of the hardships suffered by the survivors of the Mongol invasion...

He led his followers through the desert... to the oasis...
Get behind me. She's mine.
She's here!
You're going to be okay.
Got to lower the water first...
We're ready to fire.
We'll have to rebuild half of the upper village when the invaders are gone.

none of us have been down there in generations.
<via radio> Sentry teams,
Konstantin wants confirmation that the village is secure before we begin operations below the cathedral.
The cave is clear. If you head there now, you'll be safe.
Had my eye on that one for a while.

The city was a marvel... if half of this can be believed, it was the rival of Constantinople, or any of the cities of the East. Still, they feared their old enemies would find them, so they guarded their borders, and kept word of the city from spreading for as long as they could...
Like, what, exactly?
Box her in!  Move, move!
Might be able to move it...
There's not enough. We have to make do.
Shut it off! Kill the valve!
Oh god, are you all right?
We dropped one of those things, took four of us, and we still lost a man.
You can kill them but... they don't stay dead.
Too high.
Jesus, you're insatiable.
They recount the miracles of a Byzantine Prophet.
If we succeed, they'll be the first to find out.
Trinity won't need 'em anymore.
Quickly now, before it's too late.
What do you see?
Shit!
No, but I heard about it. Looks like people have been coming here to die for long time.
Maybe I could raise the water level...
Prepare to disembark...
Yeah... no telling where they could be.
This is why you don't get to hold the map.
This didn't have to be personal. I could have made it easy.
My village is in a valley on the other side of the mountain, we'll be safe there.
Konstantin wants a team up at the copper mill before the storm sets in!
On my way.
At least it isn't hailing.
Stop her!
What's Konstantin's ETA?
Hey, did you get more details about what happened underneath the cathedral?
Got to throw that oil cask through the open door.
I'm grateful for all your help, Lara. The more defenses we have, the longer we'll survive.
<triumphant shout>
You're making me work for my prize. I would have done the same.
All right, I'll give you some slack!
We never saw her coming.
Then she detonated one of the charges and collapsed half the structure...
Just a bit higher.
All right, I guess we're all gonna find out how serious Konstantin is...
The Prophet's peace...upon his word,
the armies of the North laid down their arms.
Shit! They're here!
Oh god... please...
You've got interesting timing, coming here right when our enemy arrives...
When the Emperor died, the Prophet's favor in Court died with him.
The new Emperor distrusted him, and fearing for their safety,
the Prophet and his followers fled the Imperial City with the Divine Source...
Many stayed behind, and renounced the Prophet,
but one entire Imperial Army pledged loyalty to the Prophet.
The Athanatoi.
Hold on. I think I can...
When it rains, the deer cluster together under the trees.
It's a good time to hunt, if you don't mind getting soaked.
Keep them away from the Chamber!
It's in your blood, Lara.
You're a coward, just like your father.
You don't have it in you to make the hard choices...
Hmm... maybe I'm on the wrong side of this thing...
I SEE YOU!
Journey of the Prophet...
Let's move, the rest of them can catch up.
I don't want to miss out on the hunt.
The mural shows the Prophet leading his people across the desert...
fleeing from persecution...
There was a drought... but he found a hidden oasis...
That has to be here!
My god... these are ancient...
What did they find down here?
There.
A mural of the Mongol invasion. There was a great battle, and much of the city was lost.
Fire through the walls!
Fire again! I'll shoot the fireball when it's right above him!
Not originally.
They came looking for precious minerals, but...
found something else.
What seems to be the problem?
Even damaged, the artistry is stunning.
The Mongol road led right into the bear's cave... got to get back in there...
Trinity has come at last. They're here for the Source...
Forced to pray...
Wha...!  Damn!
We still need all the intel we can gather from the prison.
Too close...
We?
Lara:  Incredible...
It's some kind of marker...
I can't quite make out the translation.
But this word...
<whispering> Prophet!
This is it...
Dad was right.
You could ask them, but... none of them made it out of here.
No... damn it.
Sulfur... this must have been where they prepared the raw ingredients for Greek Fire...
I hope so too.
It worked...
The Order of Trinity that chased our ancestors into hiding are dead and gone. How could these be the same people?
Could use that as an anchor.
Oh shit!
No!
Come on...
You're going to die!
Shit.
If we see anything, we'll sound the horns.
That's being charitable...
Most of these men would be dead, if you hadn't joined us.
We owe you a great debt.
Oh shit... what the hell was that?
That should burn as well...
Hello.
There's something stuck in the mechanism....
A mongol siege tower. What happened here?
From the chatter I heard, sounds like they think they found the Atlas.
This weather is going to make it hard to get the choppers airborne...
Collapsed...
I can't now. But I'll be back this way soon.
Need to reach the top of the tower... but that ice is in the way.
I wouldn't count on it.
Find the Atlas, double time, and let's get the hell out of here.
I'll do whatever I can.
I wouldn't hold out long for answers...
So, tell me again why NVGs aren't a part of our kit?

Check all these doors!

Trying to get that door open, same as us.

Kill them! Kill them all!
I can't, not just yet.
Lara:  They have Jonah now... and the Atlas.
But if they think he knows something,
there's still a good chance they're keeping him alive.
I just hope Jonah can hold out long enough for me to find him.
I have to get him back.
I won't let him die here.
Hang on Jonah, I’ll find you.
Where the hell are they coming from!?
Of course.
Doesn't make any sense. This side of the valley... it's almost temperate.
We may have broken Trinity here,
but if there's one thing we know,
they never forget.
You'd better watch yourself.
Do not let them escape. Shoot the runners!
The catacombs... we'll be safe there.

First things first. Worry about that later.

Try leaving the city once in a while.

Damn...

File a complaint.

<via radio> All units, respond! We've got to deal with her.

The natives have a settlement on the other side of the mountain.
Soon. You will have your day.

You're sentimental about her... the Croft girl. I can tell because she's still alive.

What I've sacrificed! What I face-
<coughing>
I'm fine.
Life has not been kind to either of us.

I promise you, all of this will be worth it in the end.
With the Divine Source, you will live.
But more importantly, you will live in a world cleansed of sin.
Send your men to this settlement. Find out what they know.
Lara:  It's too dangerous.

Always.
Jacob:  What are you doing?!
'Mankind shall be judged, the non-believers turned to ash and swept away.

<alarms resound throughout the complex>

The Pilgrim Path... Like Jacob said... it's got to be...
Shit!

Need to detonate those fireballs near the chopper.

Jacob's people have been through so much, yet they continue to fight.

a duty handed down from the past.

<via radio> We still haven't located the missing survey team.
That's still our primary objective. Eyes open.

Clear. Continuing the sweep.
Time to turn the wheel...

We have to bring them down.
We keep going until the last moment.

Make them count.

The followers of the Prophet fled to the East.

Now!

INCOMING!
